# Third-party assets

Brimholt's 2D art is generated by `tools/generators/make_sprites.py`; the 3D renderer uses the
CC0 packs below. The only third-party assets are listed here. Only CC0 (public domain) assets are allowed; never import ripped,
proprietary, or Tibia-derived art. Keep each pack's original license file beside it.

| Pack | Author | License | Source | Files used | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Particle Pack 1.1 | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack | `kenney_particle_pack/`: light_01, circle_05, spark_04, star_06, smoke_04, magic_03, slash_02, flare_01 | Downscaled from 512 to 128 px |
| KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers 1.0 | Kay Lousberg (kaylousberg.com) | CC0 1.0 | https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0 | `kaykit_adventurers/characters/`: Knight, Barbarian, Mage, Rogue, Rogue_Hooded (.glb, textures); `gear/`: weapons, shields, spellbooks (.gltf) | None |
| KayKit Medieval Hexagon Pack 1.0 | Kay Lousberg (kaylousberg.com) | CC0 1.0 | https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Medieval-Hexagon-Pack-1.0 | `kaykit_medieval_hexagon/nature/`: trees and rocks; `props/`: barrel, crates (.gltf, shared texture) | None |

Credit to Kenney and to Kay Lousberg is appreciated but not required by CC0.
